tests.title: REQ-1: successfully register a new account and remain signed in

scenario.name: Register with valid information and remain signed in

steps.content: An unauthenticated visitor has prepared a unique account and passenger information that meet the rules.
The visitor fills out the registration form, accepts the Terms of Service, and clicks `Next`.
The system saves the account and creates a session. The homepage displays the username and `Sign out`, and the session remains active after a page refresh.

tests.title: REQ-1: reject a duplicate username without creating a signed-in session

steps.content: The system already contains the same username or an email whose content is the same despite different letter casing.
The visitor submits the registration form again.
The system returns a duplicate-account error. The original account remains unchanged, and no new account or session is created.

tests.title: REQ-1: reject duplicate email with a different username

steps.content: The system already contains the same username or an email whose content is the same despite different letter casing.
The visitor submits the registration form again.
The system returns a duplicate-account error. The original account remains unchanged, and no new account or session is created.

tests.title: REQ-1: reject mismatched passwords without creating a signed-in session

scenario.name: Reject missing or incorrectly formatted information

steps.content: The registration information has a missing required field, an invalid format, an invalid date, a weak password, mismatched passwords, or an unaccepted agreement.
The visitor submits the registration form.
The page displays the corresponding error. The system creates neither an account nor a login session.
